quotes.text: We also read in the Bible that Hilkiah the high priest found in the Temple, at the time of its repair, the long-lost Book of the Law of the Lord, given by Moses ; and that he delivered his discovered treasure into the hands of Shaphan the scribe, who carried it to the king, sayings “ Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book.” This, too, our opponent, of course* readily believes, and would…
